en: Jose Rizal could speak and write in at least twenty-two different languages during his lifetime.
A Philippine President can only serve a single six-year term and is not allowed to run for re-election.
The Philippine Eagle, our national bird, has a massive wingspan that can reach up to two meters.
Marcela Agoncillo, her daughter Lorenza, and Delfina Herbosa sewed the first official Philippine flag in Hong Kong.
The Ifugao people carved the magnificent Banaue Rice Terraces into the mountains using only simple hand tools.
Filipino scientist Gregorio Zara invented the first two-way video telephone in 1955, decades before it became common.
The Ati-Atihan festival in Kalibo, Aklan, is widely recognized as the mother of all Philippine festivals.
The Philippines has over one hundred eighty distinct living languages spoken across its thousands of islands.
Gabriela Silang bravely led an Ilocano revolt against Spain after her husband Diego was assassinated by authorities.
The Office of the Ombudsman has the legal power to investigate and dismiss any public official accused of corruption.
Juan Luna won a gold medal at the 1884 Madrid Exposition for his massive and dramatic Spoliarium painting.
The eight rays of the sun on the Philippine flag represent the first eight provinces that revolted against Spain.
